nodes.specification:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: one square vocabulary illustration for a Japanese listening game
Style/medium: simple flat cartoon, rounded natural silhouettes, solid fills, clean smooth dark-purple exterior outlines; understated charm. No gradients, 3D, watercolor, paper grain, sketch marks or photorealism.
Palette: ink #3f2468, pink #ff85b5, orange #ff9d47, yellow #ffe178, lavender #af86ef, sky blue #91d7ed, green #a6dbad, warm skin #ffcf9c. White and neutral gray allowed. Factual colors such as flags and named colors override decorative palette.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent outer background with an alpha channel; no painted white backdrop, checkerboard, frame or rounded card border.
Composition/framing: square canvas, primary subject centered and fully visible, typically 65–75 percent of canvas; generous margin. Context is subordinate. Maintain legibility at 145px.
Line system: rounded caps and joins; exterior stroke approximately 7 units on a 256-unit canvas. Keep apparent line weight consistent across single and grouped subjects, simplify detail for small groups; no hairline details below one pixel at 145px.
Constraints: literal recognizable subject, accurate anatomy, exact quantities. No answer captions, translations, decorative badges, logos, watermarks, shadows or unrelated props. Only render text/numerals if explicitly essential to the subject, character, quantity, calendar or factual sign. An attractive mnemonic is not proof of an unambiguous meaning.

Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: one square vocabulary picture for a Japanese listening game
Style/medium: match the supplied Kikimashta cat PNG's polished cartoon illustration language. Smooth rounded substantial forms, clean bold deep-violet contours, restrained soft tonal shading inside forms and gentle dimensional color. Warm golden-yellow/amber, rich violet/lavender and soft pink accents. Softer, calmer rendering than a glossy clip-art sticker. No bright white shine streaks, exclamation-shaped glare, photographic texture, watercolor or sketch strokes.
Input image role: STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Study the cat's contour treatment, gentle shading, color relationships and simple forms. Do not reproduce the cat, headphones, paws, logo, lettering, Mount Fuji, torii, blossoms, sound marks, enclosing card or footer.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent outer background with an alpha channel. No painted white backdrop, checkerboard, lavender or cream tint, colored vignette, decorative scene or frame. Preserve opaque white subject details. A sky scene may contain blue sky and clouds within its intended silhouette, but no ground or horizon strip.
Composition/framing: one clear centered primary subject or the minimal action scene required by the word, full silhouette visible, about 65–75 percent of square canvas, generous margin. Readable at 145px.
Color: use the reference's warm golden and violet family for decorative accents. Preserve the factual/teaching color of the subject, including yellow banana, blue paint, green shoots and white clouds.
Constraints: correct anatomy, recognizable literal vocabulary subject, no answer labels, words, letters, branding, watermark, frame or decorative extras. Match the visual style rather than copying the cat's subject or background.

nodes.outstandingFeedback: Basketball v4 is accepted for now to proceed. Improve its seam geometry and restore a more natural tilted angle with a recognizable seam intersection in a later pass.
nodes.referenceGuidance: Shared ball design: an orange basketball at the preferred tilted three-quarter angle, with a clearly visible off-center seam crossing. Keep two main grooves crossing clearly and bowed side channels connecting at separate points; preserve a recognizable basketball junction instead of showing only parallel arcs. Dark-purple exterior outline, slightly narrower purple grooves and broad orange panels. Reuse for ordinary toy/sports balls while preserving intended count, size and spatial relations; keep specifically implied baseballs, beads, marbles, yarn balls and small jar counters appropriate to their own scene. Current v4 reference is accepted provisionally, with an unresolved seam/angle improvement. Do not treat its seams as a finished design standard; retain the improvement note when planning dependent artwork.

Shared mountain design: purple slopes with white snow caps and dark-purple outlines. Preserve scene-specific features: ordinary mountains have closed summits, while an erupting volcano needs a visible open crater with connected plume and lava; snow may remain on unaffected flanks only. Keep Fuji's characteristic profile when Fuji is the subject.

Shared uncooked rice design: medium-small slender tapered ivory kernels, roughly 1/8 to 1/10 of the bag opening width in the still life, intermediate between the oversized v1 and tiny v2. Keep grains individually readable at quiz size with light economical detail, not thick purple outlines or peanut-like plump ovals. Do not apply the bag still life to a rice-paddy landscape.

Shared stone design: a slightly angular irregular gray silhouette with restrained mineral speckles, short cracks and a few broad natural planes. Avoid a smooth blob, symmetric gem facets or sparkles. Keep texture sparse enough to read at quiz size; scale this treatment for boulders.
